TASK: move slow end-to-end tests out of PR CI into the existing nightly run, and drop the redundant CI fast-feedback job.

BACKGROUND: .github/workflows/test.yml runs on every PR and push to main: 'Static checks', 'fast-feedback' (scripts/quick_suite.py, a subset of the suite on one runner, ~5 min, the slowest job) and six 'test-shard' jobs that together run the WHOLE suite (`pytest -q --no-cov -n 4 --shard-index N --shard-count 6`), and 'deploy-staging' needs all of them. .github/workflows/coverage-nightly.yml runs the whole suite daily in six shards with --cov and gates 90% coverage. A timed run showed ~120 test functions (whole-game journeys, bench/probe/harness dry runs that run a script's main() end to end, corpus/persona replays) take ~75% of suite time. The owner decided: these go nightly, EXCEPT tests in tests/test_spine_expected_reveals.py, tests/test_narration_corpus.py and tests/test_canon_journey.py, which stay in PR CI.

The exact test functions to move are listed one per line (`tests/<file>.py::<function>`) in /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/nightly-functions.txt (69 functions). Mark EVERY function in that file and NO other test. Mark at the function level (a parametrized function is marked as a whole, all its cases). Use a decorator `@pytest.mark.nightly` on each function; do not use file-level pytestmark unless every test function in that file is on the list.

OWNED FILES (edit nothing else): the test files named in that list (decorator lines and a `import pytest` if missing, nothing else), tests/conftest.py, pyproject.toml (marker registration only), .github/workflows/test.yml, .github/workflows/coverage-nightly.yml, scripts/regen_shard_durations.py, tests/test_regen_shard_durations.py, tests/shard_durations.json, docs/testing-runbook.md, docs/test-suite-performance-guide.md.

DO:
1. Register a `nightly` marker in pyproject.toml markers (one line: slow end-to-end test that runs in the nightly workflow, not PR CI).
2. tests/conftest.py: add a `--run-nightly` option. Without it, deselect (pytest_deselected hook, not skip) every item carrying the nightly marker, in pytest_collection_modifyitems BEFORE the shard assignment, so shards balance only what runs. With it, run everything. Keep all existing collection guards and shard logic unchanged otherwise.
3. .github/workflows/test.yml: delete the fast-feedback job and remove it from every `needs` list. Leave the test-shard jobs' command unchanged (nightly tests are deselected by default). .github/workflows/coverage-nightly.yml: add `--run-nightly` to the shard pytest command; change nothing else there.
4. scripts/regen_shard_durations.py: (a) bug: the default full run includes tests/test_regen_shard_durations.py::test_real_manifest_covers_test_files, which fails exactly when files are missing, so the script then refuses to write. Pass `--deselect tests/test_regen_shard_durations.py::test_real_manifest_covers_test_files` to its pytest runs. (b) Durations are measured on the default selection (without --run-nightly), because PR shard balance is what matters; say so in one docstring line. Update tests/test_regen_shard_durations.py only if needed. Then regenerate tests/shard_durations.json with the default full run of the script, and in notes state the result of `tests/test_shard_balance.py`.
5. Docs: in docs/testing-runbook.md replace the CI fast-feedback command line with `TMPDIR=/tmp uv run pytest -q --run-nightly  # full suite including nightly end-to-end tests`, and fix the sentence `CI and pre-merge verification still run the complete suite.` to say PR CI skips tests marked nightly and the nightly workflow runs them. In docs/test-suite-performance-guide.md update the CI paragraph (no fast-feedback job; shards skip nightly tests; coverage-nightly runs everything with --run-nightly) and add one sentence: mark a new end-to-end test that takes more than about 2 seconds `@pytest.mark.nightly`. Keep both docs short; no counts, dates or results.
6. Measure and write to notes: wall time of `pytest -q --no-cov -n 4` (the PR selection) and of `pytest -q --no-cov -n 4 --run-nightly`, and the numbers of selected/deselected tests. Also run the PR selection once with `--cov --cov-report=term --cov-fail-under=0 -n 4` and report the total coverage percent (the 90% gate stays nightly; do not change coverage settings).
